name: Univention Corporate Server Domain Controllers
name_zh: Univention Corporate Server 網域控制站
summary: LDAP bind failures and password spraying, privileged group changes, account and password changes, DNS spoofing records, management console logins, configuration registry changes, UCS secret and CA files and DC service failures on UCS / Samba 4 AD domain controllers, plus optional Samba audit (logons, Netlogon, Kerberos tickets, password, group and directory changes).
summary_zh: UCS / Samba 4 AD 網域控制站的 LDAP bind 失敗與密碼噴灑、特權群組變更、帳號與密碼變更、DNS 偽冒記錄、管理主控台登入、組態登錄（UCR）變更、UCS 機密與憑證機構檔案及 DC 服務失敗，並可選用 Samba 稽核（登入、Netlogon、Kerberos 服務票證、密碼、群組與目錄變更）。
notes: A UCS domain controller already sends /var/log/syslog and /var/log/auth.log to Wazuh, but Wazuh decodes only the OpenLDAP connection and bind lines. LDAP writes, the UCS directory logger, the management console's PAM lines and the Samba init script arrived undecoded. Meanwhile the built-in rules produced noise: every LDAP connection was a level 3 alert (rule 2508, about 7,000 a day on one UCS primary), and every management console login raised two level 5 authentication failures, because UCS tries the local password before Kerberos.

LDAP bind failures (err=49) are level 5 with the account and source address. They are level 8 for admin, Administrator, root, krbtgt or a UCS join account, and level 10 when one address fails eight times in two minutes. Failed binds for five different accounts from one address within five minutes are level 10 too (password spraying, 131465): one account mistyped many times does not count, a slow rate per account does. A machine account (cn=...,cn=computers) failing is level 3, recognised from its own BIND line: it happens briefly at each machine password change (measured: two a month per DC). Successful binds are level 2. Most are per-request API authentications: measured about 12,600 a day on one primary, 6,600 of them by cn=admin or Administrator. They become level 5 from an address outside the private ranges, 8 for admin-class accounts from there, and 10 after three or more failures from the same address in ten minutes. Connection alerts are recorded below the alert level. A child of rule 2508 stops the built-in rule 2509 from ever firing (verified), so rule 131401 takes its place. That applies to every OpenLDAP server reporting to the manager.

Writes to the UCS directory, read from slapd's stats log (log level 256). Any write to a privileged group is level 12. Those groups are Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, Schema Admins, Administrators, the built-in operator groups, DnsAdmins, Group Policy Creator Owners, Domain Controllers, and the UCS groups DC Backup Hosts, DC Slave Hosts, Backup Join and Slave Join. A new domain controller object, a change to cn=admin, or the deletion of a privileged account is level 10. A new computer object is level 5. A DNS record named *, wpad or isatap is level 10 (131429): any domain user may create DNS records in an AD zone, and these names let one host answer for other names (ADIDNS spoofing). Measured: five DNS record additions in 30 days on one domain, none of these names. Users created, deleted or renamed and groups created or deleted are level 3. A user's password set or changed is level 5, and a privileged account's is level 10. Machine password changes and ordinary attribute changes are recorded only. Measured on one domain: no write to a privileged group in twelve weeks, and 115 user creations and deletions in 30 days, all from automated test runs. Expect similar churn from your own test tooling and from the S4 connector. The stats level costs one syslog line per LDAP operation: measured about 137,000 lines a day on a busy Primary, about 1.6 events a second to the manager; searches are recorded at level 0.

What a slapd alert can and cannot say. Each line is one LDAP operation. The alert names the operation and the DN, and adds the bound account and source address that Wazuh carries over from earlier lines of the same connection. It cannot say which member was added to a group, and it shows no values. If a client binds twice on one connection, the first identity is reported. Long-lived connections usually show no bound account; one example is the S4 connector, which writes every change made on the Samba side. Local tools connect from the DC itself, so their source address is the DC. A password alert names the connection and operation; the account is the MOD line just before it on that connection.

With the UCS directory logger enabled (ldap/logging=yes), its syslog line adds the account that committed each change. A privileged group change is level 12 again, this time with that account. A change made by a person (a uid= account, that is the management console or the REST API) is level 3. Changes by services and machines are recorded only. Measured: 0 to 138 lines a day, median 1. Never collect /var/log/univention/directory-logger.log. Its records contain the password hashes of every changed account (userPassword, krb5Key, sambaNTPassword, pwhistory).

Management console logins. From PAM: an ordinary account is level 2, the first login of an account on a DC is level 3 (fts), and an admin-class account (Administrator, admin, root, a join account) is level 3. A login after three failed logins of the same account in ten minutes is level 10. From the web server log, which has the client address but not the account: a login from a private address is level 2 and one from an external address level 5. A login after three rejections from the same address in ten minutes is level 10. A rejected login (HTTP 401 on /univention/auth) is level 5, and eight rejections from one address in two minutes are level 10. The PAM step that always fails for domain accounts is recorded only. Measured: 16 logins in five weeks, all by Administrator.

Nothing depends on site data. Domain controllers log in to each other over SSH with their machine accounts for sysvol replication, about 576 times a day per DC. These are recognised by the trailing $ of the account: the SSH login, its PAM sessions and the local password failures before Kerberos are recorded only (level 2), and the same login from an external address is level 8. File share sessions (pam_unix(samba:session)) are level 2, or 3 for an admin-class account; on one primary there are about 1,900 a day, from a monitoring account, anonymous sessions and machine accounts. Measured effect on two DCs: about 3,600 level 3 alerts a day less on the primary and about 1,000 on the backup. Optional tuning: list the DCs' short host names in etc/lists/jt-ucs-dc-hosts. Then the local password failures before Kerberos of every domain account on those hosts are recorded only, and a root SSH login with a password there is level 8 instead of 3.

Services. Samba AD DC stopping is level 5: it stops at every machine password change (every 21 days by default, at 01:00) and at updates. A failed samba-ad-dc or slapd unit is level 10, a failed listener, notifier or S4 connector level 8, a failed management console server level 5. The sssd-pam socket failures seen on UCS 5.2 (about 60 a day) already produce no alert and are left alone.

What a UCS DC does not log by default, so this pack cannot see it without the optional steps: Kerberos and NTLM logons and their failures (Samba runs at log level 1); password, group membership and other directory changes made on the Samba side, with their actor; and the Admin Diary, which goes to the diary backend and is kept out of /var/log/syslog. Account lockout is disabled unless the site sets a lockout threshold (samba-tool domain passwordsettings), so password guessing against Kerberos is neither throttled nor logged.

Optional and recommended: Samba's JSON audit, each class routed to a file of its own and sent by the agent group with the program name samba-audit (setup guide). Versions 1.0 and 1.1 expected a header ('samba[pid]: JSON Authentication:') that no current Samba writes, so these rules never fired; 1.2 decodes the line as Samba 4.21 writes it (two leading spaces) and as 4.24 does (none). A failed Kerberos, NTLM or Netlogon logon is level 5 with account, service and source address; level 6 for a disabled or expired account, 7 for a locked-out one, 8 for a privileged account. Ten failures from one address in five minutes are level 10, failures for six different accounts from one address are level 10 (password spraying, 131469), and about twenty failed Netlogon authentications from one address within ten seconds are level 12 (Zerologon-style, CVE-2020-1472, 131471). A member added to or removed from a privileged group is level 12, with the member and the acting SID. A password reset is level 5, or level 10 for a privileged account. With the directory change class (dsdb_json_audit:5): an access control list change on the domain root or AdminSDHolder is level 12 (DCSync rights, persistence), a service principal name or Kerberos delegation set on an account is level 8 (targeted Kerberoasting, resource-based constrained delegation), a new NTDS Settings object or a DC-only SPN on a non-DC is level 12 (new or rogue DC, DCShadow), a Group Policy change or link is level 8, and a wildcard or WPAD DNS record is level 10. Successful logons and Kerberos service tickets are logged only at auth_json_audit:3, which is high volume. If enabled, logons follow the login policy (level 2, a new (account, address) pair 3, admin-class 3, external 5 or 8, after three failures from the same address 10), and one user account asking for tickets to about twelve different services within a minute is level 10 (possible Kerberoasting, 131479). Samba does not log the ticket's encryption type, so an RC4 request cannot be singled out. The lines were built from the Samba 4.21 source and tested through the agent's logcollector into an alert in a sandbox manager; check them against the first real lines.

Optional: the Admin Diary. One rsyslog rule on the diary backend writes it to a file; it then records who did what through UDM (level 3). A change to a privileged group is level 12, to the Administrator account level 7; machine password changes are recorded only. For group events the object is assumed to be in the argument 'group'.

Active responses are offered for repeated LDAP bind failures and LDAP password spraying, repeated rejected management console logins, and repeated Samba authentication failures, Samba password spraying and Netlogon bursts from one address. Blocking on a domain controller cuts that address off from Kerberos, LDAP, DNS and file shares on that DC. Read each risk before enabling one. A response enabled before 1.2 keeps its old rule list until it is switched off and on again.

Files (file integrity monitoring of /etc, which the agent does by default). UCS rewrites several of its own files on a schedule: the configuration registry and its .bak copies, the S4 connector caches, BIND's statistics, the updater's files, the LDAP Diffie-Hellman parameters and the machine password (every 21 days). Each was a level 7 alert of rule 550: measured 83 on two DCs on one day, 69 of them these files; they are level 2 now (131457). A change of content in the online component repository list is level 5 (an app or repository was added or removed). A change to /etc/ldap.secret (the cn=admin password), /etc/ldap-backup.secret or the domain CA's key or certificate is level 12 (131459). On a Backup or Replica node, failed.ldif appearing means LDAP replication to it stopped: level 10 (131468, the group adds that directory to monitoring). The group also marks the secret files and /etc/univention/ssl as nodiff, so no diff of them is stored or sent even where report_changes is on. /etc/fstab changes at every scan on the measured DCs; that is left to the site.

Configuration registry changes. With ucr/replog/enabled=yes, UCS writes every ucr set and unset to /var/log/univention/config-registry.replog; the agent group sends it. Every change is level 2 (measured: about one a day on one Primary, the updater's statistics key). Keys that weaken authentication or switch off the logging this pack depends on are level 8 (131467): the LDAP stats level, the directory logger, Samba's log level and global options, NTLM, LDAP strong authentication, SMB signing and minimum protocol, weak Kerberos crypto, SSH root and password login, the firewall switch and default policy, PAM access lists, account lockout, LDAP ACL switches and the password quality policy. Installing an app can set PAM access keys; check such alerts against the change. Two limits: UCR checks ucr/replog/enabled after a change, so switching the change log off is itself never written; and a value is sent as it is set, so do not keep passwords in UCR variables.

Cross-pack login groups (patch release): jt_auth_success on 131462, 131463, 131472, 131487, 131494, 131488, 131489, 131436, 131444, 131445; jt_auth_failure on 131460, 131473, 131474, 131476; jt_auth_lockout on 131475. They let jt-account-guard correlate logins across services and jt-ioc look up the address of every tagged successful login; levels and matching are unchanged, and without those packs the groups do nothing. One copy per login: the management console is tagged on its web server line (131460, 131462, 131463, which carry the client address) and not on its PAM lines (131431-131438, account only). OpenLDAP binds (131401, 131403, 131406) are not tagged: almost every bind is another service checking a password it was given, so tagging them would count each failed login twice, once with the service as the source. Samba logs an Authentication and an Authorization line for one network logon; 131472 takes both. 131461 and 131464 now count the management console failures through the pack-only group jt_ucs_umc_web_failure (on 131460 only) instead of if_matched_sid 131460: same rule, same thresholds, but the failures also reach the cross-pack group lists, which skip any rule named by an if_matched_sid.
notes_zh: UCS 網域控制站本來就會把 /var/log/syslog 與 /var/log/auth.log 送給 Wazuh，但 Wazuh 只解碼 OpenLDAP 的連線與 bind 行。LDAP 寫入、UCS directory logger、管理主控台的 PAM 記錄、Samba 啟動腳本送進來後都沒有解碼。同時內建規則製造雜訊：每一條 LDAP 連線都是 level 3 告警（規則 2508，一台 UCS 主控約每天 7,000 筆）；每次登入管理主控台會產生兩筆 level 5 的驗證失敗，因為 UCS 先試本機密碼、再試 Kerberos。

LDAP bind 失敗（err=49）為 level 5，附帳號與來源位址。admin、Administrator、root、krbtgt 或 UCS 的 join 帳號失敗為 level 8；同一位址兩分鐘內失敗八次為 level 10。同一位址五分鐘內有五個不同帳號 bind 失敗也是 level 10（密碼噴灑，131465）：同一個帳號打錯很多次不算，每個帳號只試一兩次的慢速嘗試會算。機器帳號（cn=...,cn=computers）失敗為 level 3，由它自己的 BIND 行辨認：每次更換機器密碼時會短暫發生（實測：每台 DC 每月兩次）。成功的 bind 為 level 2，多半是每個請求都要做的 API 驗證：一台主控實測每天約 12,600 次，其中 6,600 次是 cn=admin 或 Administrator。來自私有網段以外的位址時為 level 5，admin 類帳號為 8；同一位址十分鐘內失敗三次以上之後成功為 level 10。連線告警記錄在告警等級之下。規則 2508 一旦有子規則，內建規則 2509 就永遠不會觸發（已驗證），因此由規則 131401 取代它。這一點對所有回報到此 manager 的 OpenLDAP 伺服器都適用。

UCS 目錄的寫入，取自 slapd 的 stats 記錄（log level 256）。任何對特權群組的寫入為 level 12。特權群組包括 Domain Admins、Enterprise Admins、Schema Admins、Administrators、內建的各種 Operators 群組、DnsAdmins、Group Policy Creator Owners、Domain Controllers，以及 UCS 的 DC Backup Hosts、DC Slave Hosts、Backup Join、Slave Join。新的網域控制站物件、cn=admin 被修改、特權帳號被刪除為 level 10；新的電腦物件為 level 5；名稱為 *、wpad 或 isatap 的 DNS 記錄為 level 10（131429）：AD 區域預設任何網域使用者都能新增 DNS 記錄，而這些名稱能讓一台主機替其他名稱應答（ADIDNS 偽冒）。單一網域實測：30 天內新增五筆 DNS 記錄，沒有一筆是這些名稱。建立、刪除、更名使用者，建立或刪除群組為 level 3。使用者密碼被設定或變更為 level 5，特權帳號為 level 10。機器帳號密碼變更與一般屬性變更只記錄。單一網域實測：十二週內沒有任何特權群組寫入；30 天內 115 次使用者建立與刪除，全部來自自動化測試。貴站自己的測試工具與 S4 connector 也會造成類似的變動量。stats 等級的成本是每個 LDAP 操作一行 syslog：繁忙的 Primary 實測每天約 137,000 行，送到 manager 約每秒 1.6 筆；搜尋操作記錄為 level 0。

slapd 告警能說什麼、不能說什麼：每一行是一個 LDAP 操作。告警寫出操作與 DN，並加上 Wazuh 從同一連線先前幾行帶過來的 bind 帳號與來源位址。它說不出群組加入或移除了哪個成員，也不顯示任何值。同一連線 bind 兩次的用戶端，回報的是第一次的身分。長時間不斷線的連線（例如會寫入 Samba 端所有變更的 S4 connector）通常沒有 bind 帳號；本機工具從 DC 本身連線，所以來源位址是 DC。密碼告警寫出連線與操作編號；帳號在同一連線緊接在前的 MOD 行。

啟用 UCS directory logger（ldap/logging=yes）後，它的 syslog 行會補上提交每筆變更的帳號。特權群組變更同樣為 level 12，並附上這個帳號；由人（uid= 帳號，也就是透過管理主控台或 REST API）做的變更為 level 3；服務與機器做的變更只記錄。實測每天 0 到 138 行，中位數 1。絕對不要收集 /var/log/univention/directory-logger.log：其中每筆被變更帳號的記錄都含有密碼雜湊（userPassword、krb5Key、sambaNTPassword、pwhistory）。

管理主控台登入。PAM 端：一般帳號為 level 2，某帳號第一次登入某台 DC 為 level 3（fts），admin 類帳號（Administrator、admin、root、join 帳號）為 level 3；同一帳號十分鐘內登入失敗三次以上之後成功為 level 10。網頁伺服器記錄有用戶端位址但沒有帳號：來自私有位址的登入為 level 2，來自外部位址為 level 5；同一位址十分鐘內被拒絕三次以上之後成功為 level 10。被拒絕的登入（/univention/auth 回應 HTTP 401）為 level 5，同一位址兩分鐘內被拒絕八次為 level 10。網域帳號必然失敗的那一步 PAM 只記錄。實測：五週內 16 次登入，全部是 Administrator。

不依賴任何站台資料。網域控制站之間以機器帳號透過 SSH 互相登入做 sysvol 複寫，每台 DC 每天約 576 次。這些依帳號結尾的 $ 辨認：SSH 登入、對應的 PAM 工作階段、以及 Kerberos 之前的本機密碼失敗都只記錄（level 2）；同樣的登入若來自外部位址則為 level 8。檔案分享工作階段（pam_unix(samba:session)）為 level 2，admin 類帳號為 3；一台主控每天約 1,900 次，來自監控帳號、匿名工作階段與機器帳號。兩台 DC 實測效果：主控每天約少 3,600 筆 level 3 告警，備援約少 1,000 筆。選用調校：把 DC 的短主機名稱列入 etc/lists/jt-ucs-dc-hosts，這些主機上所有網域帳號在 Kerberos 之前的本機密碼失敗都只記錄，root 以密碼透過 SSH 登入則從 level 3 升為 8。

服務：Samba AD DC 停止為 level 5，它在每次更換機器密碼（預設每 21 天、凌晨 01:00）與更新時都會停止。samba-ad-dc 或 slapd 服務失敗為 level 10，listener、notifier 或 S4 connector 失敗為 level 8，管理主控台伺服器失敗為 level 5。UCS 5.2 上的 sssd-pam socket 失敗（每天約 60 次）本來就不產生告警，套件不處理。

UCS 網域控制站預設不記錄、因此本套件不做選用步驟就看不到的事：Kerberos 與 NTLM 登入及其失敗（Samba 執行在 log level 1）；在 Samba 端做的密碼、群組成員與其他目錄變更以及執行者；Admin Diary（它送到 diary 後端，並被排除在 /var/log/syslog 之外）。除非網站設定了鎖定門檻（samba-tool domain passwordsettings），帳號鎖定是關閉的，所以對 Kerberos 的密碼猜測既不會被限制，也不會被記錄。

選用、建議啟用：Samba 的 JSON 稽核，每一類寫到各自的檔案，由 agent 群組以程式名稱 samba-audit 送出（見部署說明）。1.0 與 1.1 預期一個目前的 Samba 都不會寫的開頭（「samba[pid]: JSON Authentication:」），所以這些規則從未觸發過；1.2 依 Samba 4.21 實際寫出的格式（開頭兩個空白）與 4.24 的格式（沒有空白）解碼。Kerberos、NTLM 或 Netlogon 登入失敗為 level 5，附帳號、服務與來源位址；停用或過期帳號為 level 6，被鎖定的帳號為 7，特權帳號為 8。同一位址五分鐘內失敗十次為 level 10；同一位址有六個不同帳號失敗為 level 10（密碼噴灑，131469）；同一位址十秒內約二十次 Netlogon 驗證失敗為 level 12（Zerologon 類攻擊，CVE-2020-1472，131471）。成員加入或移出特權群組為 level 12，附成員與執行者的 SID。密碼重設為 level 5，特權帳號為 level 10。啟用目錄變更類別（dsdb_json_audit:5）後：網域根或 AdminSDHolder 的存取控制清單變更為 level 12（DCSync 權限、持續性）；在帳號上設定服務主體名稱或 Kerberos 委派為 level 8（針對性 Kerberoasting、以資源為基礎的限制委派）；新的 NTDS Settings 物件、或非 DC 物件出現 DC 專用的 SPN 為 level 12（新的或偽造的 DC，DCShadow）；群組原則變更或連結為 level 8；萬用字元或 WPAD 的 DNS 記錄為 level 10。成功的登入與 Kerberos 服務票證只在 auth_json_audit:3 才會記錄，數量很大。若啟用，登入依登入政策處理（level 2，新的（帳號, 位址）組合 3，admin 類帳號 3，外部位址 5 或 8，同一位址失敗三次之後成功 10）；同一個使用者帳號一分鐘內要求約十二種不同服務的票證為 level 10（可能是 Kerberoasting，131479）。Samba 不記錄票證的加密類型，因此無法單獨找出 RC4 的請求。這些記錄行依 Samba 4.21 原始碼建構，並在沙箱 manager 中經 agent 的 logcollector 一路測到告警；請以最初的真實記錄核對。
選用：Admin Diary。在 diary 後端加一條 rsyslog 規則把它寫到檔案後，會記錄誰透過 UDM 做了什麼（level 3）；特權群組變更為 level 12，Administrator 帳號變更為 level 7；機器密碼變更只記錄。群組事件的物件假設放在參數「group」。
提供三種主動回應：同一位址一再 LDAP bind 失敗或 LDAP 密碼噴灑、一再被管理主控台拒絕登入、一再 Samba 驗證失敗、Samba 密碼噴灑或 Netlogon 爆量嘗試。在網域控制站上封鎖，會讓該位址在那台 DC 上的 Kerberos、LDAP、DNS 與檔案分享全部中斷；啟用前請先讀各自的風險說明。1.2 之前就已啟用的回應，要停用再啟用一次才會套用新的規則清單。

檔案（agent 預設就會對 /etc 做檔案完整性監控）。UCS 會定期改寫自己的一些檔案：組態登錄與它的 .bak 副本、S4 connector 的快取、BIND 的統計檔、更新程式的檔案、LDAP 的 Diffie-Hellman 參數，以及機器密碼（每 21 天）。這些原本都是規則 550 的 level 7 告警：兩台 DC 某一天實測 83 筆，其中 69 筆是這些檔案；現在為 level 2（131457）。線上元件套件庫清單的內容改變為 level 5（新增或移除了 app 或套件庫）。/etc/ldap.secret（cn=admin 的密碼）、/etc/ldap-backup.secret 或網域憑證機構的金鑰與憑證被修改為 level 12（131459）。Backup 或 Replica 節點上出現 failed.ldif 代表對它的 LDAP 複寫已停止：level 10（131468，群組會把該目錄加入監控）。群組也把這些機密檔與 /etc/univention/ssl 設為 nodiff，即使開啟 report_changes 也不會儲存或送出它們的差異內容。量測的 DC 上 /etc/fstab 每次掃描都會變，這交給站台處理。

組態登錄（UCR）變更。ucr/replog/enabled=yes 時，UCS 會把每一次 ucr set 與 unset 寫到 /var/log/univention/config-registry.replog，由 agent 群組送出。每一筆變更為 level 2（單一 Primary 實測：每天約一筆，是更新程式的統計值）。會削弱驗證、或關掉本套件所依賴之記錄的設定為 level 8（131467）：LDAP stats 等級、directory logger、Samba 的 log level 與 global options、NTLM、LDAP 強制驗證、SMB 簽章與最低協定、弱 Kerberos 加密、SSH 的 root 與密碼登入、防火牆開關與預設政策、PAM 存取清單、帳號鎖定、LDAP ACL 開關與密碼品質政策。安裝 app 可能會設定 PAM 存取相關的值，請對照當時的變更確認。兩個限制：UCR 在變更之後才檢查 ucr/replog/enabled，所以關閉變更記錄這件事本身永遠不會被寫下；值會照原樣送出，所以請不要把密碼放在 UCR 變數裡。

跨套件登入群組（修補版）：jt_auth_success：131462, 131463, 131472, 131487, 131494, 131488, 131489, 131436, 131444, 131445；jt_auth_failure：131460, 131473, 131474, 131476；jt_auth_lockout：131475。讓 jt-account-guard 跨服務關聯登入、jt-ioc 查詢每一筆加標記的成功登入來源位址；等級與比對條件不變，沒有安裝這些套件時群組沒有作用。每次登入只標一份：管理主控台標在網頁伺服器那行（131460、131462、131463，有用戶端位址），不標 PAM 那幾行（131431-131438，只有帳號）。OpenLDAP 的 bind（131401、131403、131406）不標：幾乎每一筆 bind 都是別的服務在驗證使用者給它的密碼，標了會讓每次登入失敗算兩次，其中一次的來源是那個服務。Samba 一次網路登入會記 Authentication 與 Authorization 兩行，131472 兩行都會收。131461 與 131464 改以只在 131460 上的套件專屬群組 jt_ucs_umc_web_failure 計算管理主控台的失敗，不再用 if_matched_sid 131460：同一條規則、同樣門檻，但失敗事件也能進入跨套件群組清單（被 if_matched_sid 指名的規則會被群組清單略過）。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: ucs
agent_group.description: UCS domain controllers: the configuration registry change log, the optional Samba JSON audit files and the Admin Diary copy (with a program name of their own), and file integrity settings for the replication directory and the secret files; syslog, auth.log and the web server log are read by the agent already

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並重新載入規則集
setup.body:
1. Install the pack from this page.
2. On the Rules tab, press Reload Ruleset. It reloads every cluster node; the cluster copies rule files to the workers but does not reload them.
setup.body_zh:
1. 在本頁安裝套件。
2. 到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」，所有叢集節點都會重新載入；叢集會把規則檔複製到 worker，但不會替它們重新載入。
setup.verify: /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t on the manager prints no error or warning.
setup.verify_zh: 在 manager 上執行 /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t，沒有任何錯誤或警告。

setup.title: Add the domain controllers to the ucs group
setup.title_zh: 把網域控制站加入 ucs 群組
setup.body:
1. Add each UCS domain controller to the ucs group and restart its agent (commands below; <agent_id> is the DC's agent ID).
2. If an agent's own ossec.conf already reads a file the group reads (the configuration registry log, the Samba audit files, the Admin Diary copy), remove that block from ossec.conf, or the group's copy is ignored.
3. Never collect /var/log/univention/directory-logger.log in any agent configuration: it contains password hashes.
setup.body_zh:
1. 把每台 UCS 網域控制站加入 ucs 群組並重啟它的 agent（指令如下；<agent_id> 是該 DC 的 agent ID）。
2. 若 agent 自己的 ossec.conf 已經在讀群組會讀的檔案（組態登錄變更記錄、Samba 稽核檔、Admin Diary 副本），請從 ossec.conf 移除那一段，否則群組的設定會被略過。
3. 絕對不要把 /var/log/univention/directory-logger.log 加入任何 agent 設定：其中含有密碼雜湊。
setup.verify: /var/ossec/bin/agent_groups -s -i <agent_id> on the manager lists ucs, and the agent list shows the group configuration as synced.
setup.verify_zh: 在 manager 上執行 /var/ossec/bin/agent_groups -s -i <agent_id> 會列出 ucs，agent 清單中群組設定顯示 synced。

setup.title: Turn on OpenLDAP stats logging (LDAP rules)
setup.title_zh: 開啟 OpenLDAP stats 記錄（LDAP 規則需要）
setup.body:
The LDAP bind and write rules need slapd at log level 256 (stats).
1. Check the value with ucr get ldap/debug/level.
2. If it does not include 256, set it and restart slapd (LDAP on that server is down for a few seconds).
setup.body_zh:
LDAP bind 與寫入規則需要 slapd 的 log level 256（stats）。
1. 用 ucr get ldap/debug/level 檢查目前的值。
2. 若不含 256，設定後重新啟動 slapd（該伺服器的 LDAP 會中斷數秒）。
setup.code:
ucr get ldap/debug/level
ucr set ldap/debug/level=256
systemctl restart slapd
setup.verify: Bind with a wrong password: ldapsearch -x -H ldap://<dc>:7389 -D uid=<user>,cn=users,<base> -w wrong -b '' -s base. Expect rule 131401 (level 5).
setup.verify_zh: 以錯誤密碼 bind：ldapsearch -x -H ldap://<dc>:7389 -D uid=<user>,cn=users,<base> -w wrong -b '' -s base，應出現規則 131401（level 5）。

setup.title: Turn on the configuration registry change log
setup.title_zh: 開啟組態登錄變更記錄
setup.body: Rules 131466 and 131467 read /var/log/univention/config-registry.replog, which the ucs group sends. On each DC, check ucr/replog/enabled; if it is not yes, set it (commands below). No restart is needed.
setup.body_zh: 規則 131466 與 131467 讀取 /var/log/univention/config-registry.replog，由 ucs 群組送出。請在每台 DC 檢查 ucr/replog/enabled，若不是 yes 就設定它（指令如下）。不需要重新啟動任何服務。
setup.code:
ucr get ucr/replog/enabled
ucr set ucr/replog/enabled=yes
setup.verify: The second command, run when the value is already yes, writes the same value again. Expect rule 131467 (level 8) naming ucr/replog/enabled.
setup.verify_zh: 值已經是 yes 時再執行第二個指令，會以相同的值重寫一次，應出現規則 131467（level 8）並寫出 ucr/replog/enabled。

setup.title: Install the UCS directory logger (who made each change)
setup.title_zh: 安裝 UCS directory logger（記下每筆變更是誰做的）
setup.body:
On the Primary Directory Node only, install univention-directory-logger (no service interruption); ucr get ldap/logging then shows whether it is on. Its syslog line names the account behind each directory change.
Do not collect its own file, /var/log/univention/directory-logger.log: it contains password hashes.
setup.body_zh:
只在 Primary Directory Node 安裝 univention-directory-logger（不會中斷服務）；之後可用 ucr get ldap/logging 確認是否已開啟。它的 syslog 記錄會寫出每筆目錄變更是由哪個帳號做的。
不要收集它自己的檔案 /var/log/univention/directory-logger.log：其中含有密碼雜湊。
setup.verify: Change a user's description in the management console. Expect rule 131441 (level 3) naming your account.
setup.verify_zh: 在管理主控台修改某個使用者的描述，應出現規則 131441（level 3），並寫出你的帳號。

setup.title: Turn on the Samba JSON audit
setup.title_zh: 開啟 Samba JSON 稽核
setup.body:
1. If you followed the 1.0 or 1.1 guide, remove the old debug syslog format setting (first command).
2. Set the log level through UCR (second command) and check it with testparm (third).
3. Add the logrotate rule for the new files (UCS sets max log size = 0).
4. Restart samba-ad-dc one DC at a time: Kerberos, Samba LDAP, DNS updates and file shares on that DC stop for about ten seconds.
auth_json_audit:2 logs failed Kerberos, NTLM and Netlogon logons; the ucs group sends the files with the program name samba-audit.
setup.body_zh:
1. 若曾依 1.0 或 1.1 的說明設定，請移除舊的 debug syslog format 設定（第一個指令）。
2. 透過 UCR 設定 log level（第二個指令），並用 testparm 確認（第三個）。
3. 為新檔案加上 logrotate 規則（UCS 設定了 max log size = 0）。
4. 一次只重新啟動一台 DC 的 samba-ad-dc：那台 DC 的 Kerberos、Samba LDAP、DNS 更新與檔案分享會中斷約十秒。
auth_json_audit:2 記錄 Kerberos、NTLM 與 Netlogon 的登入失敗；ucs 群組會以程式名稱 samba-audit 送出這些檔案。
setup.code:
ucr unset 'samba/global/options/debug syslog format'
ucr set 'samba/global/options/log level=1 auth_json_audit:2@/var/log/samba/jt-audit-auth.log dsdb_password_json_audit:5@/var/log/samba/jt-audit-password.log dsdb_group_json_audit:5@/var/log/samba/jt-audit-group.log'
testparm -sv 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^\s*log level ='
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/jt-samba-audit <<'EOF'
/var/log/samba/jt-audit-*.log {
	weekly
	rotate 12
	compress
	missingok
	notifempty
	copytruncate
}
EOF
systemctl restart samba-ad-dc
setup.verify: kinit <user> with a wrong password against this DC. Expect a JSON line in /var/log/samba/jt-audit-auth.log and rule 131473 (level 5) with the client address. If the file stays empty, check the log level with testparm; some systems write the per-class files only with a base level of 3, which makes log.samba much larger.
setup.verify_zh: 對這台 DC 以錯誤密碼執行 kinit <user>，/var/log/samba/jt-audit-auth.log 應出現一行 JSON，並出現附用戶端位址的規則 131473（level 5）。若檔案一直是空的，請用 testparm 檢查 log level；某些系統要把基本等級設為 3 才會寫入各類別的檔案，這也會讓 log.samba 大很多。

setup.title: Optional: audit Samba directory changes
setup.title_zh: 選用：稽核 Samba 目錄變更
setup.body:
Appends dsdb_json_audit to the log level of the previous step (commands below), then restart samba-ad-dc (same impact). Rules 131496-131499 and the Samba part of 131429 need it.
It writes one line per directory write on that DC: enable it on one DC for a day and check the size of /var/log/samba/jt-audit-dsdb.log before the others.
setup.body_zh:
在上一步的 log level 後面加上 dsdb_json_audit（指令如下），然後重新啟動 samba-ad-dc（影響相同）。規則 131496-131499 與 131429 的 Samba 部分需要它。
這台 DC 上每筆目錄寫入都會寫一行：請先在一台 DC 上啟用一天，看過 /var/log/samba/jt-audit-dsdb.log 的大小，再決定其他 DC。
setup.code:
ucr get 'samba/global/options/log level'
ucr set "samba/global/options/log level=$(ucr get 'samba/global/options/log level') dsdb_json_audit:5@/var/log/samba/jt-audit-dsdb.log"
systemctl restart samba-ad-dc
setup.verify: Add a service principal name to a test user (samba-tool spn add HTTP/test.example.com <user>). Expect rule 131497 (level 8); remove it again with samba-tool spn delete.
setup.verify_zh: 替一個測試使用者加上服務主體名稱（samba-tool spn add HTTP/test.example.com <user>），應出現規則 131497（level 8）；之後用 samba-tool spn delete 移除。

setup.title: Optional: log successful logons and service tickets
setup.title_zh: 選用：記錄成功登入與服務票證
setup.body:
Raises auth_json_audit from 2 to 3 (commands below), then restart samba-ad-dc (same impact). Samba then logs every successful Kerberos and NTLM logon and every Kerberos service ticket, which the Samba login rules and the Kerberoasting rule 131479 need.
This is high volume (every logon and ticket of every client of that DC): enable it only where that is acceptable.
setup.body_zh:
把 auth_json_audit 從 2 提高到 3（指令如下），然後重新啟動 samba-ad-dc（影響相同）。Samba 之後會記錄每一次成功的 Kerberos 與 NTLM 登入以及每一張 Kerberos 服務票證，Samba 登入規則與 Kerberoasting 規則 131479 需要這些記錄。
數量很大（這台 DC 所有用戶端的每一次登入與每一張票證）：只在可以接受的地方啟用。
setup.code:
ucr set "samba/global/options/log level=$(ucr get 'samba/global/options/log level' | sed 's/auth_json_audit:2@/auth_json_audit:3@/')"
ucr get 'samba/global/options/log level'
systemctl restart samba-ad-dc
setup.verify: Log on to a domain member and open a file share. Expect level 2 or 3 logon alerts (131472, 131494) and recorded service tickets (131478) from that client.
setup.verify_zh: 在網域成員上登入並開啟檔案分享，應出現該用戶端的 level 2 或 3 登入記錄（131472、131494）與已記錄的服務票證（131478）。

setup.title: Optional: write the Admin Diary to a file
setup.title_zh: 選用：把 Admin Diary 寫到檔案
setup.body:
On the Admin Diary backend only (it receives the entries of every UCS host): create the rsyslog rule and the logrotate rule below, then restart rsyslog (logging pauses for a moment).
Keep the 00- prefix of the file name: the rule must sort before the backend's own rule, which drops ADMINDIARY entries.
setup.body_zh:
只在 Admin Diary 後端設定（它會收到所有 UCS 主機的項目）：建立下方的 rsyslog 規則與 logrotate 規則，然後重新啟動 rsyslog（記錄會短暫暫停）。
檔名要保留 00- 開頭：這條規則必須排在後端自己那條會丟掉 ADMINDIARY 項目的規則之前。
setup.code:
cat > /etc/rsyslog.d/00-jt-admindiary.conf <<'EOF'
if $syslogtag == 'ADMINDIARY:' then action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/univention/jt-admindiary.log" template="RSYSLOG_FileFormat")
EOF
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/jt-admindiary <<'EOF'
/var/log/univention/jt-admindiary.log {
	weekly
	rotate 12
	compress
	missingok
	notifempty
	copytruncate
}
EOF
systemctl restart rsyslog
setup.verify: Create a test user in the management console. Expect rule 131490 (level 3) naming your account.
setup.verify_zh: 在管理主控台建立一個測試使用者，應出現規則 131490（level 3），並寫出你的帳號。

setup.title: Optional: list the domain controllers
setup.body:
Not needed: machine accounts, sessions and replication logins are recognised without it. On listed DCs, the local password failure before every Kerberos login is only recorded (instead of the built-in level 5), and a root SSH login with a password is level 8.
Add one line per DC with its short host name as it appears in that DC's /var/log/syslog (<dc_name> below), then reload the ruleset. Updates and removal of the pack leave this file alone.
setup.body_zh:
不是必要的：機器帳號、工作階段與複寫登入不靠名單就能辨認。列入名單的 DC 上，每次 Kerberos 登入之前的本機密碼失敗只記錄（不再是內建的 level 5），root 以密碼透過 SSH 登入則為 level 8。
每台 DC 一行，寫該 DC 在自己 /var/log/syslog 中的短主機名稱（下方的 <dc_name>），然後重新載入規則集。更新或移除套件都不會動這個檔案。
setup.verify: Log in to the management console as an ordinary account on a listed DC. Expect no level 5 unix_chkpwd alert for that login.
setup.verify_zh: 在列入名單的 DC 上以一般帳號登入管理主控台，這次登入不應再出現 level 5 的 unix_chkpwd 告警。

setup.title: Without Internet access
setup.body:
Nothing in this pack downloads anything on the manager. The only download is the univention-directory-logger package on the Primary (directory logger step): install it from the site's local UCS repository (or a repository mirror reachable from the Primary).
Without it only the directory logger rules 131440-131443 stay silent; the slapd and Samba rules still work.
setup.body_zh:
這個套件在 manager 上不會下載任何東西。唯一需要下載的是 Primary 上的 univention-directory-logger 套件（directory logger 那一步）：請從站台自己的 UCS 本機套件庫（或 Primary 連得到的套件庫鏡像）安裝。
沒有它時只有 directory logger 規則 131440-131443 不會觸發，slapd 與 Samba 的規則照常運作。
setup.verify: On the Primary, apt-cache policy univention-directory-logger shows a candidate version from the local repository.
setup.verify_zh: 在 Primary 上執行 apt-cache policy univention-directory-logger，應看到來自本機套件庫的候選版本。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing LDAP binds on a domain controller
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖在網域控制站上一再 LDAP bind 失敗的位址
active_response.body: After eight failed binds from one address in two minutes, or failed binds for five different accounts within five minutes (password spraying), all traffic from that address to the DC where it happened is dropped for 10 minutes (iptables or nftables on the DC). Risk: in a UCS domain most LDAP clients are member servers, applications and the other DCs. A server with a stale service-account password would lose Kerberos, LDAP, DNS and file shares on that DC, and the logons of its users fail. A DC blocking another DC stops replication. Put the DCs, member servers and management networks in the manager's white_list first. UCS rebuilds its firewall rules when univention-firewall restarts, which removes a block early.
active_response.body_zh: 同一位址兩分鐘內 bind 失敗八次、或五分鐘內有五個不同帳號 bind 失敗（密碼噴灑）後，在發生的那台 DC 上封鎖該位址的所有流量 10 分鐘（DC 上的 iptables 或 nftables）。風險：UCS 網域中多數 LDAP 用戶端是成員伺服器、應用程式與其他 DC。服務帳號密碼過期的伺服器會在那台 DC 上失去 Kerberos、LDAP、DNS 與檔案分享，其使用者的登入也會失敗；DC 封鎖另一台 DC 會使複寫停止。請先把 DC、成員伺服器與管理網段加入 manager 的 white_list。univention-firewall 重新啟動時 UCS 會重建防火牆規則，封鎖會提早解除。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to the management console
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入管理主控台失敗的位址
active_response.body: After eight rejected logins from one address in two minutes, all traffic from that address to that DC is dropped for 10 minutes. The block applies to the whole DC, not only to the web interface: a workstation at that address also loses its domain logon, file shares and DNS on that DC. If a reverse proxy sits in front of the management console, every user behind it is blocked. Put the proxy and management networks in the manager's white_list first.
active_response.body_zh: 同一位址兩分鐘內被拒絕登入八次後，在那台 DC 上封鎖該位址的所有流量 10 分鐘。封鎖作用於整台 DC，不只是網頁介面：該位址的工作站也會在那台 DC 上失去網域登入、檔案分享與 DNS。若管理主控台前面有反向代理，代理後的所有使用者都會被擋。請先把代理與管理網段加入 manager 的 white_list。

active_response.title: Block an address with repeated Kerberos, NTLM or Netlogon failures (needs the Samba audit)
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再 Kerberos、NTLM 或 Netlogon 失敗的位址（需要 Samba 稽核）
active_response.body: After ten failed logons from one address in five minutes, failed logons for six different accounts (password spraying), or a burst of failed Netlogon authentications (Zerologon-style), all traffic from that address to that DC is dropped for 10 minutes. Requires the optional Samba JSON audit. Risk: a legitimate workstation with stale cached credentials (a mapped drive or service still using an old password) fails repeatedly by itself; blocking it means that machine cannot log on to the domain through that DC. A NAT or VPN gateway blocks everyone behind it. Domains with more than one DC let clients fail over, which limits the outage but also the protection. Put servers, gateways and management networks in the manager's white_list first.
active_response.body_zh: 同一位址五分鐘內登入失敗十次、有六個不同帳號登入失敗（密碼噴灑）、或爆量的 Netlogon 驗證失敗（Zerologon 類攻擊）後，在那台 DC 上封鎖該位址的所有流量 10 分鐘。需要選用的 Samba JSON 稽核。風險：快取憑證過期的正常工作站（仍用舊密碼的對應磁碟機或服務）會自己一再失敗；封鎖它代表那台電腦無法透過該 DC 登入網域。NAT 或 VPN 閘道會讓其後所有人都被擋。網域有多台 DC 時，用戶端會轉向其他 DC，這減輕了中斷，也削弱了防護。請先把伺服器、閘道與管理網段加入 manager 的 white_list。
